preregistration.grid_assignment_rule: target i -> node i % 25 (row-major), jitter within own cell
preregistration.pass_enumeration_rule: per target: coarse incidence scan over the span at enum_step_s, in-band runs refined by a 33-point local grid per edge (resolution enum_step_s/32), runs clustered into passes at gap_merge_s; per pass t_ca = vector-squint minimum of the segment; windows = incidence runs n envelope n end-check n AASR (AD-2/AD-6)

predecessor_comparison.note: window width is a physical quantity here, so overload ratio is not comparable to the M-family value at equal N without accounting for the geometry
predecessor_comparison.this_topology: single dense domain (5x5 grid, 250 km spacing, 1000 km side, centre 20N/0E), enumerated real-orbit transits
